notes.title: Notes for v1.06
notes.content:
Hopefully the player position bug in the later areas is fixed now, please report if it happens again.
Some secret new stuff coming soon, stay tuned. 

Fixes:
- Player collision bug 
- Terrain issues
- Made a later puzzle icon more clear
- Cat dialogue bug fixed
- Guy in park dialogue/quest improved
- Invisible NPC fixed
- Some malfunctioning textures
